name: Task management
description: A local productivity app with persistent tasks and deterministic acceptance criteria.

requirements.text: Create a task with a required title. Reject blank titles.
requirements.acceptance: Submitting a blank title shows an error and does not add a task.

requirements.text: Toggle a task between active and complete.
requirements.acceptance: Toggling twice restores the initial status.

requirements.text: Filter tasks by status and title substring.
requirements.acceptance: Completed filter excludes active tasks and combines with text search.

requirements.text: Persist tasks across reloads using local storage.
requirements.acceptance: Reload restores titles and completion state.

requirements.text: Provide keyboard-accessible labeled controls and an empty state.
requirements.acceptance: All task actions are reachable by Tab and empty filters explain the state.
